description.p: Vistava is a chill, minimalist viewer for images and videos. It makes browsing your media simple - on any device.

ul.li: Browse your image and video library in peace
Navigate via mouse, keyboard, touch screen, or gamepad
Share your media to a TV, smartphone, or VR headset within your network
View content from third-party sources with optional extensions

description.p: The first stable release of Vistava, featuring the following changes and improvements:

ul.li: Easier installation of extensions directly from within the application
Added configuration option for reduced animation mode
Various minor bugfixes

description.p: The fourth beta release, featuring the following changes and improvements:

ul.li: Extension support for alternative media sources
Editable configurations for keybindings and certain application settings
Added feature to open items and directories from Vistava in OS file explorer
Various bugfixes and UI/UX improvements

description.p: The third beta release, featuring the following changes and improvements:

ul.li: New thumbnail generation system using ffmpeg and ImageMagick on both Windows and Linux
Added experimental flatpak deployment (via flatpak file) to support more Linux distributions (replacing the AppImage and DEB versions)
Added built-in support for the 8BitDo Micro Bluetooth Gamepad
Various smaller bugfixes and improvements

description.p: The second beta release, featuring the following changes and improvements:

ul.li: Thumbnails for directories and playlists were redesigned to take less space
Icons have been cleaned up and improved
Experimental support for the image formats TIFF, PSD and DDS was added
Videos now loop by default
Various smaller bugfixes and usability improvements
